label: requires request parameter
type: the subject construct only works when the object request-level parameter is supplied on the query request.
note: Establishes the request tier of the Query service's three-tier settings model (request / node / cluster), which the registry previously flattened: requiresSetting covered cluster and node settings and was being stretched to cover per-request parameters too. Promoted together with the three n1ql:*-level-query-settings concepts so the tiers are nameable, not just implied.
